title: Kapfenberg Storm Back From 0-2 to Dethrone Oberwart for an Eighth Crown
description: Down 0-2 and staring at the end of their season, the Kapfenberg Bulls did not flinch. The Styrians reeled off three straight wins to stun the two-time defending champion Oberwart Gunners, capping the comeback with a 94-80 Game 5 victory at home to claim the win2day Basketball Superliga title the eighth championship in the club's history. It is a comeback with an echo: the only other time Kapfenberg overturned a 0-2 deficit to win a best-of-five final was in 2003, against Gmunden. As winners of the regular season and the placement round, the Bulls had entered the series as the top seed, only to drop two tight games. From there they flipped the script entirely.
imageCaption: Kapfenberg overturn series from 0-2 to 3-2 and clinch title (Photo: basketballaustria.at)
